title: Completed coefficient adjunct and module direct image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, and $d=(A,I)$ a Noetherian adic coefficient datum with finite perfect positive quotients. Write $A_X,A_Y$ for the completed coefficient sheaves and $\operatorname{Mod}(A_X),\operatorname{Mod}(A_Y)$ for their module categories [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Use the small pro-etale inverse-image/direct-image adjunction $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$, with unit $\eta$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], and its canonical completed coefficient map $c_f:f^{-1}A_Y\to A_X$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Define $c_f^\#:A_Y\to f_*A_X$ to be $\eta_{A_Y};f_*(c_f)$. Define completed module direct image $f_{*,d}:\operatorname{Mod}(A_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(A_Y)$ by $(f_{*,d}M)(U)=M(u_f(U))$, with the $A_Y(U)$-action obtained by restricting the $A_X(u_f(U))$-action along $(c_f^\#)_U$. Its restriction maps and its maps on module morphisms are those of sectionwise direct image.
